mirHTm2T4qYv2kXJY5zaEw.zh: 全球於7月共32個國家新增通報1,370例確診、7例死亡, 智利及匈牙利近期首次通報Clade Ib基因型境外移入確定病例,個案發病前均具歐洲國家旅遊史,歐洲多國存在Clade Ib社區傳播 。另WHO啟動新的疫苗國際協調機制(ICG),並將常規建議延⻑至2027年8月,強調疫情雖未達「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」標準,惟各締約國仍應依據該建議,維持公衛監測、風險溝通及防治應變機制 。WHO評估全球疫情仍持續,整體風險為中。
mirHTm2T4qYv2kXJY5zaEw.en: Globally in July, 32 countries newly reported 1,370 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. Chile and Hungary recently reported, for the first time, imported confirmed cases of clade Ib; all had a history of travel to European countries before symptom onset, and several European countries have community transmission of clade Ib. WHO has launched a new international vaccine coordination mechanism (ICG) and extended its standing recommendations to August 2027. WHO stresses that although the outbreak does not meet the criteria for a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), States Parties should continue public health surveillance, risk communication and response measures in line with the recommendations. WHO assesses that the global outbreak continues and that the overall risk remains moderate.

5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,多國自去(2025)年12月截至今年5月中旬累計報告至少83例病例,其中至少20例住院,病患以兒童及年輕人為多,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疫情分布於丹麥、匈牙利、捷克、法國等9個歐洲國家,經調查疑感染源為雞肉相關產品,受影響國家已要求廠商將相關產品下架。
5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.en: European outbreak update: between December 2025 and mid-May 2026, multiple countries reported at least 83 cases, of which at least 20 were hospitalised. Cases are mainly among children and young people. Genotyping identified Salmonella Stanley ST2045. The outbreak is spread across nine European countries, including Denmark, Hungary, Czechia and France. Investigations suggest the suspected source is chicken-related products, and affected countries have asked manufacturers to withdraw the products from the market.

_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.zh: 中歐多國爆發疫情,其中奧地利、捷克、匈牙利、斯洛維亞今年截至10月累計報告逾6,000例病例,其中41-80%住院,病患多為街友或毒品使用者等脆弱族群,病毒型別涵蓋兩組相近的IB型,此波疫情遠高於去年,並已擴及9個歐洲國家,另迄未發現食源性傳播跡象。
_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.en: Several Central European countries have experienced outbreaks. Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported more than 6,000 cases cumulatively as of October this year, of which 41–80% were hospitalised. Most patients belong to vulnerable groups, such as homeless people or people who use drugs. The virus types include two closely related genotype IB clusters. This outbreak is far higher than last year's and has spread to 9 European countries. No evidence of foodborne transmission has been found so far.

lIIsUtYBEBanhfHQegW-1Q.zh: 匈牙利疫情上升,今年截至11月中旬已累計63例嬰兒病例,其中21例死亡,病例數較去年(42例)增加50%,並以該國東部死亡率為高,多為低社經族群,當局已擴大孕婦篩檢措施。另該國為歐盟區2022年女性梅毒發病率最高的國家之一。
lIIsUtYBEBanhfHQegW-1Q.en: Hungary's situation is rising. As of mid-November this year, 63 infant cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 21 died. This is a 50% increase over last year (42 cases). Mortality is highest in the east of the country, mainly among lower socioeconomic groups. Authorities have expanded prenatal screening. Hungary is also one of the EU countries with the highest rate of female syphilis in 2022.

_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.zh: 義大利疫情更新,今年迄今累計582例病例及39例死亡(CFR:15%),其中有260例病例發生侵犯神經系統症狀,病例主要分布於拉吉歐及坎帕亞大區。歐洲今年截至9/3,包括義大利、希臘、塞爾維亞、法國、羅馬亞、匈牙利、西班牙、阿爾巴亞及保加利亞等國均有報告本土病例。
_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.en: Italy's outbreak update: so far this year, 582 cases and 39 deaths have been reported (CFR: 15%), of which 260 cases had neuroinvasive symptoms; cases are mainly in the Lazio and Campania regions. As of 3 September this year, locally acquired cases have been reported in Europe in several countries, including Italy, Greece, Serbia, France, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Albania and Bulgaria.

XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.zh: 義大利疫情上升,今年迄今累計173例病例及11例死亡,其中72例病例出現神經症狀。歐洲今年截至8/6,包括保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、匈牙利、羅馬亞等6國均曾報告確診病例。
XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.en: Italy's outbreak is rising: so far this year, 173 cases and 11 deaths have been cumulatively reported, of which 72 cases had neurological symptoms. As of 6 August this year, six European countries, including Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy, Hungary and Romania, had reported confirmed cases.

kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.

DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.zh: 全球疫情更新,匈牙利疫情嚴峻,今年截至5月累計報告641例病例,為去年同期7倍;英國於6/12公布近期累計95例病例,其中58例住院,經調查推估有兩起群聚事件,其中1起之感染源為超市食品;印度南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala)於6/11報告51例病例,其中21例來自同一地區,懷疑為相同感染源,當局已發布疫情警報;中國今年截至5月累計報告近1萬例病例,為去年同期1.5倍。
DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.en: Global update: Hungary's outbreak is severe. As of May this year, 641 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7 times the same period last year. On 12 June, the UK published that 95 recent cases had been reported cumulatively, 58 of whom were hospitalized. Investigation estimates two clusters, one of which had a food source from a supermarket. In Kerala State in southern India, 51 cases were reported on 11 June, 21 of them from the same area; they are suspected to share the same source, and authorities have issued an outbreak alert. China reported nearly 10,000 cumulative cases as of May this year, 1.5 times the same period last year.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals.
